1879060631.name: Challenge
1879060631.desc: Draws enemy threat away from your allies.

1879073559.name: Silvan Shadows
1879073559.desc: Although untrained, you have the natural ability to move about unseen, though there is a chance enemies may detect you, especially when moving in front of them.

1879094935.name: The Melody of Battle
1879094935.desc: This melody inspires you or your target to better know the fluid nature of battle, providing them swift blades and manoeuvres that dishearten their foes. When traited in The Protector of Song, it will also occasionally increase threat generation.\n\n<rgb=#00FFDD>This skill is only available in Resonance.</rgb>

1879097879.name: Eye Rake
1879097879.desc:
A swift swipe meant for the eyes.<rgb=#FF7700> 
 
 In Flayer: Eye Gash 
 Brute bonus: Decreases block, parry, and evade rating. 
 
 In Shadow: Eye Gouge 
 From stealth: Decreases range of target's ranged skills.  </rgb>

1879139735.name: Mephitic Kiss
1879139735.desc: A ranged attack which sprays a contact poison at targets, causing damage over time.

1879157399.name: Strong Sweep
1879157399.desc: A strong AOE strike that is used occasionaly.

1879202327.name: Sword of Gondor
1879202327.desc: A damaging sword strike to a single enemy.

1879209879.name: Steed of the Minstrel
1879209879.desc: A mount carrying all the trappings that are used and needed by the minstrel.

1879210775.name: Improved Vital Target
1879210775.desc: Your knowledge of the enemy is so great that you can target vital organs with great efficacy, and focus yourself for subsequent attacks.

1879229975.name: Yule Festival Snowy Pony
1879229975.desc: A pony from the Yule Festival.

1879231255.name: Fist and Javelin
1879231255.desc: Mastery over the Fist: Allows Warden to perform Fist Gambits quickly.

1879232407.name: Ranged Safeguard
1879232407.desc: A quick strike, which damages the enemy and heals you over time.

procEffects.description: When enemies Block, Parry, or Evade your attacks, you have a chance of quickly following up from another angle, dealing:

1879239575.name: Flay Open
1879239575.desc: You draw back your blade to carve a shallow gash through your enemy's flesh.

1879252887.name: War-steed: Medium
1879252887.desc: The Rouncey is a moderately armoured War-steed. The Rouncey provides balance and stability without sacrificing or favouring survivability or manoeuvrability.

1879260055.name: Improved Swift Bow: Star-light
1879260055.desc: Loose three missiles in rapid succession.\n\nArrows inflict Light damage.

conditionalEffects.description: Swift Bow has a chance to make Merciful Shot available.

1879260311.name: Burglar's Treat
1879260311.desc: A Burglar is not always about tricks. Sometimes a treat is in order.\n\nThis skill gives you and your allies a temporary buff.

1879266839.name: Righteousness Arrow
1879266839.desc: These arrows will make servants of the Eye burn, fearing as they do the goodness of the Dúnedain.

1879270551.name: Pinning Shot
1879270551.desc: A short range attack that will briefly root the target.

conditionalEffects.description: Ranged Focus Spenders increase your Ranged Damage until your next Ranged Focus Builder.

1879314839.name: Guide to Dol Amroth
1879314839.desc: Returns you and your Fellowship to Dol Amroth in western Gondor.\n\nThis skill is easily interrupted.

1879335447.name: Steed of the Summer Sea
1879335447.desc: A pony from the Summer Festival.

1879344535.name: Faroth
1879344535.desc: Summons the tracking hound, Faroth. After your adventures together in The Wastes, he is eager to keep your company.

1879365655.name: Lasgalen Spring Steed
1879365655.desc: A steed dressed to celebrate spring.

1879394583.name: Badger
1879394583.desc: Brings out a badger to keep you company.

1879457559.name: Javelin of Fate
1879457559.desc: A lunge which deals shorter, more potent Light damage over time.

procEffects.description: When enemies Block, Parry, or Evade your attacks, you have a chance of quickly following up from another angle, dealing:

1879458199.name: Amber Fire-fly
1879458199.desc: Summons a friendly fire-fly to accompany you on your journeys.

1879466263.name: Sail to Dol Amroth
1879466263.desc: Navigate to Dol Amroth with nearby fellows.

1879475991.name: Guide to Lond Cirion
1879475991.desc: Returns you and your Fellowship to Lond Cirion.\n\nThis skill is easily interrupted.

1879485335.name: Whimsical Woodland Critters
1879485335.desc: Summons a small group of woodland critters to accompany you on your adventures.

1879486487.name: Maned Lion
1879486487.desc: Summons a stalking lion to accompany you on your travels.

1879488023.name: Friend of the Wilds (Tomb-guardian)
1879488023.desc: Summons a Bog-guardian companion.\n\nThe Bog-guardian excels at dealing damage from range.

1879508631.name: Pale Scorpion
1879508631.desc: Summons a pale scorpion to accompany you on your travels.

1879508759.name: Guide to Zajâna
1879508759.desc: Returns you and your Fellowship to Zajâna in Kighân in Mûr Ghala.\n\nThis skill is easily interrupted.

1879516695.name: Drop Red Mushroom
1879516695.desc: Drop your current mushroom.\n\n<rgb=#00ff00>The mushroom will explode when dropped.</rgb>

1879521303.name: Armoured Desert Wasp
1879521303.desc: Summons an armoured desert wasp to accompany you on your travels.
